articles.title: CBIC Constitutes Working Group to Examine Centralised Administration of Taxpayers with Multiple GST Registrations
articles.excerpt: A strategic working group has been established by the CBIC to review audit protocols and coordinate multiple state tax registrations under a single point.
articles.author: Saima
articles.content: The Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) has set up a specialized working group to look into the feasibility of centralized tax administration for entities holding multiple GST registrations. This step is expected to simplify compliance procedures for large conglomerates and reduce conflicting state-level interpretations.

articles.title: CBIC Issues Guidelines for Departmental Appeals to GSTAT in Common Adjudicating Authority Cases
articles.excerpt: Vetted procedures for departmental appeals before the GSTAT under recent notifications have been released by the indirect tax board.
articles.author: Saima
articles.content: New guidelines govern how tax authorities will approach the GST Appellate Tribunal (GSTAT) in cases involving common adjudicating authorities. The aim is to ensure consistency in disputes and streamline representations before tribunal benches.

articles.title: ITAT Rules Reassessment Notices Where Escaped Income Ultimately Fell Below Rs 50 Lakh Threshold As Unsustainable
articles.excerpt: The Income Tax Appellate Tribunal has quashed reassessment proceedings where the tax officer's assessment of escaped income fell below the statutory Rs 50 Lakh bar.
articles.author: Saima
articles.content: In a significant ruling, the ITAT clarified that reassessment proceedings under Section 148 cannot be sustained if the final computed escaped income falls short of the ₹50 lakh statutory threshold. This safeguards taxpayers from prolonged litigation on lower-valued adjustments.

articles.title: ITR Deadline July 31: No Official Extension Yet, Experts Warn Taxpayers to File Immediately
articles.excerpt: Compliance professionals recommend corporate and individual assessees submit ITRs before the standard window closes to avoid interest and late fees.
articles.author: Vanshika verma
articles.content: With the July 31 deadline fast approaching, tax professionals urge taxpayers to file their returns immediately. The Ministry of Finance has indicated that no timeline extensions are currently under consideration, making early compliance crucial.

articles.title: Technical Mistake In Mentioning Correct Provision Cannot Be A Reason To Deny Section 12AB Registration: ITAT
articles.excerpt: The Appellate Tribunal held that statutory tax exemptions for charitable trusts cannot be rejected based solely on typographical or formatting errors.
articles.author: Saloni Kumari
articles.content: Exemption applications under Section 12AB should be reviewed on their substance. The ITAT ruled that mere technical mistakes in specifying the correct sub-clause of application forms cannot form the sole grounds for denying registration.

articles.title: ITAT Grants Major Tax Relief to BSNL VRS Employees Exempting Compensation Under Section 10(10C)
articles.excerpt: A milestone ruling confirming that voluntary retirement compensation for public telecom employees is fully exempt from tax up to ₹5 lakh.
articles.author: Jasmine
articles.content: Concessions under voluntary retirement schemes (VRS) are protected. The ITAT confirmed that benefits received by telecom employees under the VRS package qualify for income tax exemptions under Section 10(10C).

articles.title: ROC Compliance & MCA21 V3 Portal: A Practitioner's Survival Guide
articles.excerpt: Tips and workflows for navigating the Ministry of Corporate Affairs portal for LLP and Company annual filings.
articles.author: CA. Rahul Sharma
articles.content: Form filings on the upgraded MCA V3 portal require profile associations. CAs must update credentials to business user roles to avoid late filing penalties.
